typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Value Date} as string,
		From as string,
		To as string,
		Amount as string,
		CCY as string,
		Confirmation as string,
		Status as string,
		Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Load_Date = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Type as string,
		Amount as double,
		CCY as string,
		Value_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		From as string,
		To as string,
		Confirmation as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		Type,
		Amount,
		CCY,
		Value_Date = {Value Date},
		From,
		To,
		Confirmation,
		loadDate = Load_Date),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
